7.t: Working with data: putting it all together
q: What was the temperature of liquid A after 10 minutes?
By how much did each liquid cool in 20 minutes?
A: 25 − 15 = 10 degrees C. B: 25 − 22 = 3 degrees C.
Explain why both liquids got colder.
Evaporation: the fastest particles escape from the surface, so the particles left behind have less energy on average: the liquid cools.
Which liquid evaporates faster? Explain your answer and suggest one way to make the test fairer.
Liquid A: it cooled much more, so more fast particles escaped. Fairer: the same volume and same dish for each, the same fan distance, the same starting temperature, and repeat the test.
